Messages.Author: lovre
Messages.Body:
Glutton
Type: Master
Requires: Ishtarri
Cost: X pool
Unique master.
This card costs X pool, where X is the number of Gluttons in your ash
heap. Put this card in play. You may tap this card to untap a ready
Ishtarri you control. That Ishtarri burns 1 blood. Any vampire may burn
this card as a (D) action.

Rarity: LoB:R

Ayo untaps via glutton. Does she burn the 1 blood immediately, or can
she theoretically play telepathic misdirection before the "That Ishtarri
burns 1 blood." effect kicks in?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The former. You cannot interrupt the effect of tapping Glutton to play
Telepathic Misdirection.
